tbesh_html:
Tabor = "mound"
n pr mont
a city of the Merarite Levites located in the territory of Zebulun
Another name of ke.sul.lot (כְּסֻלּוֹת "Chesulloth" H3694)

strongs_1890.strongs_def: Tabor, a mountain in Palestine, also a city adjacent
strongs_1890.derivation: from a root corresponding to H8406 (תְּבַר); broken region;
